The /live/auth0/read API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

AuthorizeExternalConnectionResponse Model - Response for authenticating with an external brokerage or data provider for a live algorithm.
authorization object
example: {'alpaca-access-token': '37a2c4f3-7b1c-41a4-b103-197a88ef2a4d'}
Authentication information from the data provider or brokerage, including the access token or refresh token.
success boolean
Indicate if the API request was successful.
errors string Array
List of errors with the API call.
Example 
{
  "authorization": {
    "alpaca-access-token": "37a2c4f3-7b1c-41a4-b103-197a88ef2a4d"
  },
  "success": true,
  "errors": [
    "string"
  ]
}

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
